import json
from qb.bitcount import bitcount

CASES = [[[127], 7], [[128], 1], [[3005], 9], [[13], 3], [[14], 3]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = bitcount(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "bitcount(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
